verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs say users can export financial statements on cash or accrual basis in Excel, CSV and PDF, and get real-time financial reports with one click. Reconciliation is documented as underpinning report accuracy. However, the evidence never names the P&L, balance sheet or cash-flow statement individually, and never shows that reports can be run for any chosen period. Missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statement documentation, custom or arbitrary period selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of statement accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: Yes, you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
Get real-time financial reports with one click
performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly—giving you 100% confidence in your financial reports.
